responsibility: Declares the predicate and condition representation used for context-sensitive IPA summaries. It defines expression-evaluation operations, parameter-derived conditions, inline_param_summary, clause_t, and the ipa_predicate class with APIs for combining, evaluating, remapping, dumping, and streaming predicates, plus add_condition for extending a function summary’s condition set. It is the type-level interface for the predicate system implemented in ipa-predicate.cc.
same_name_distinction: Defines the predicate data model and public API used by ipa-predicate.cc: expr_eval_op, condition, inline_param_summary, clause_t, and the ipa_predicate/add_condition declarations, rather than the predicate-manipulation algorithms themselves.
